The applicant is in jail since 06.12.2019.
Matter is taken up in the revised call.
None appears on behalf of the applicant to press the bail application.
Name of counsel for the applicant is shown in the cause list.
In case the counsel for the applicant does not remain present on the next date of listing, the Court may appoint an amicus curiae and proceed with the hearing of the case.
It is informed that the records of the learned AGA are not available before this Court.
The hearing of the case could not happen in absence of the records of the learned AGA.
Learned Government Advocate shall ensure that the records of the learned A.G.As are reconstructed and are available on the next date of hearing so that hearing of the matter is not impeded.
